id: LA Times, Sun, Apr 13 - "Tax Audit: The Musical"

metadata.title: LA Times, Sun, Apr 13 - "Tax Audit: The Musical"
metadata.author: Nora Pearlstone / Ed. Rich Norris & Joyce Nichols Lewis

entries.clue: Auditor: You look relaxed. How are you? Taxpayer: __ (Tommy Roe)
A: Ready to start? T: I wish I had __ (Phil Collins)
A: So you lead a rock band. Where do you perform? T: __ (Beach Boys)
T: Ever audit somebody and find they've overpaid? A: __ (Buddy Holly)
T: I couldn't find all my receipts. A: __ (Fats Domino)
Get off the road, in a way
A: Looks like you owe $10,000. T: __ (Beatles)
T: How about we just split the difference? A: __ (Hall & Oates)
A: You're looking a bit pale. T: I'm __ (Elvis)
A: You have 24 hours to arrange payment. T: (to himself) Looks like we'll be a __ (Paul McCartney & Wings)
EPILOGUE: Band member: Where can we possibly go where they won't find us? T: I'm thinking __ (Frankie Avalon)
